# slopometer

> Score prose for simplicity and precision against plain-English reference rules

## Modules

- [slopometer.cli](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/slopometer/cli.html.md): The command line: score a file or stdin, warm
- [slopometer.core](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/slopometer/core.html.md): Tells, findings, the rule registry, and what the meter cannot see
- [slopometer.features](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/slopometer/features.html.md): Continuous measurements for learned scoring
- [slopometer.lexicon](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/slopometer/lexicon.html.md): Word and phrase rules: banned vocabulary, hedges, fillers, and splices
- [slopometer.para](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/slopometer/para.html.md): Paragraph rules: restatement, elegant variation, forced symmetry, and coinage
- [slopometer.score](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/slopometer/score.html.md): Run every rule, weigh the findings, and report worst first
- [slopometer.segment](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/slopometer/segment.html.md): Markdown becomes typed blocks that keep their file positions
- [slopometer.syntax](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/slopometer/syntax.html.md): The spaCy rules: sentences, clauses, passives, and the patterns anchored to them
